purpose: Public provider manifest for Block10 route discovery and quote comparison. Providers receive no BTEN capability, treasury balance, keeper key, or browser private key. Emission gating is separate: aggregator/Cetus volume on registered BTEN pools counts toward block release via RouteRecorded or ExternalCetusRouteAttested — not via tape-only labels.

providers.name: Aftermath Smart Order Router
providers.executionRule: Use output as a direct-route comparator for display. Protected dapp-built routes prefer the BTEN Move adapter; external volume that hits registered BTEN pools is emission-gated via attestation (counts toward settle), not rejected.
providers.gateRule: Quote/compare helper only for route selection UI. If the resulting on-chain swap touches a registered BTEN Cetus pool, external attestation gates that digest for emission-block release (batch_trades / settle), not for tape labeling.

securityRules: No provider transaction is auto-submitted by the keeper.
The user's wallet signs every user transaction.
No provider receives a BTEN admin capability, upgrade capability, treasury fund, or GitHub keeper secret.
A third-party quote is not itself a RouteRecorded proof; emission gating for external Cetus BTEN legs comes from ExternalCetusRouteAttested (or an on-package RouteRecorded).
Do not block or drop trades; attest or record so they count toward block release.

liveTape.rule: Tape is display-only. Aggregator quotes are compare helpers; Cetus BTEN legs that land on-chain are attested so they count toward emission-block release.
